paper.title: Unlocking the Chemical Space for Rechargeable Batteries with a Generative Solvent Design System

paper_and_si.finding: The SI contains DC-200 model discussion and plots but no per-molecule DC-200 table, CSV, or workbook.

dataset_release_checks.paper_text: States DC-200 was curated from 200 aprotic samples measured experimentally at room temperature, citing He et al. 2025 (10.1063/5.0267184) and the Minnesota Solvation Database (MNSOL) Version 2012.
dataset_release_checks.github: The author-linked repository Teoroo-CMC/Batt-SLM was enumerated recursively (207 tree entries). It contains Batt-SLM, Batt-P30K, redox/CPI assets and RX-392, but no DC-200/dielectric table.
dataset_release_checks.zenodo: DataCite search found companion records 10.5281/zenodo.21061161 and 10.5281/zenodo.21061162, both CC-BY-4.0 + MIT and marked IsSupplementTo the paper; the two ids resolve to a single record (21061161 -> 21061162, DOI 10.5281/zenodo.21061162). The zenodo.org host name does not resolve by name in this environment, but its API answers once the host is pinned to a resolved IP, so the manifest was inspected in a follow-up check: it holds a single file, GSDS_Prior_Finetune.zip (4,746,199,417 bytes, md5 f1736827b1a9f31e85587ca2eae913a7), described as fine-tuning results and final generators. No DC-200 per-molecule table is present, so the availability conclusion is unchanged and now rests on an inspected manifest rather than an unreachable endpoint.
dataset_release_checks.mnsol: Direct MNSOL landing request failed at transport level; no MNSOL file was downloaded or used.

dc200.conclusion: No DC-200 per-molecule table/value was obtainable from the published SI, the current author repository, or indexed release metadata; this is an availability conclusion, not an inferred value.
